name: Crimson Metal Engineering Company Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1985, Crimson Metal Engineering Company Ltd is in the business of manufacturing Steel Pipes.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
CMECL is engaged in the manufacture of Electrical Resistance Welded (ERW) pipes and tubes, like Black & GI pipes, GP coils, square & rectangular pipes, 
etc.

cons: Stock is trading at 3.41 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.

Company has a low return on equity of -4.81% over last 3 years.
